_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَأيُ الرَّجُلِ مِيزانُ عَقْلِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, A persons opinion is the gauge of his intelligence.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَأيُ العاقِلِ يُنْجي
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The opinion of an intelligent person saves.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَأيُ الجاهِلِ يُردي
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The opinion of an ignorant person destroys.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَأيُ الرَّجُلِ على قَدْرِ تَجْرِبَتِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The opinion of a person is in accordance with his experience.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : زَلَّةُ الرَّأيِ تَأتي عَلَى المُلْكِ وَ تُؤْذِنُ بِالهُلْكِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Erroneous opinion annihilates the kingdom and heralds destruction.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : شَرُّ الآراءِ ما خالَفَ الشَّريعَةَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The most evil of opinions is that which goes against the laws of Islam.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صَلاحُ الرَّأيِ بِنُصْحِ المُسْتَشيرِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The validity of an opinion is [measured] by the sincerity of the adviser.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صَوابُ الرَّأيِ يُؤمِنُ الزَّلَلَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Correct opinion saves [one] from errors.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صَوابُ الرَّأيِ بِالدُّوَلِ وَ يَذْهَبُ بِذِهابِها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Correct opinion [and decision] comes with [the coming of] power and it vanishes with its disappearance.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صَوابُ الرَّأيِ بِإجالَةِ الأفكارِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Correct opinion is [derived] through careful consideration.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ضَلَّةُ الرَّأيِ تُفسِدُ المَقاصِدَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Misguided opinion corrupts the goals.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : عَلى قَدْرِ الرَّأيِ تَكُونُ العَزيمَةُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Determination [and resolve] is proportionate to the strength of ones opinion.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَدْ يَزِلُّ الرَّأيُ الفَذُّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Indeed the lone opinion [without any consultation] may be erroneous.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَدْ خاطَرَ مَنِ اسْتَغْنى بِرَأيِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Indeed one who thinks his opinion is sufficient [and does not seek advice] has taken a [huge] risk.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ جَهِلَ وُجوهَ الآراءِ أعْيَتْهُ الحِيَلُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is ignorant of the different opinions is incapacitated by ruses [and is unable to decide on the correct course].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أضاعَ الرَّأيَ إرْتَبَكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who fails to apply the [correct] opinion becomes disconcerted.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أعْمَلَ الرَّأيَ غَنِمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who acts on the [correct] opinion, benefits [from it].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ ضَعُفَتْ آراؤُهُ قَوِيَتْ أعْداؤُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One whose opinions are weak, his enemies become stronger.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أعْجَبَتْهُ آراؤُهُ غَلَبَتْهُ أعْداؤُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is impressed by his [own] opinions is defeated by his enemies.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ اُعْجِبَ بِرَأيِهِ مَلَكَهُ (أهْلَكَهُ) العَجْزُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who admires his [own] opinion is overwhelmed (or destroyed) by incompetence.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تَسْتَبِدَّ بِرَأيِكَ فَمَنِ اسْتَبَدَّ بِرَأيِهِ هَلَكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not become opinionated [and headstrong], for the one who is opinionated is destroyed.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتَسْتَعْمِلُوا الرَّأيَ فيما لايُدْرِكُهُ البَصَرُ وَ لاتَتَغَلْغَلُ فيهِ الفِكَرُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not use opinion [and conjecture] in that which is neither perceived by sight nor penetrated by thought.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا رَأيَ لِمَنْ لا يُطاعُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is not obeyed has no opinion.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ قَنِعَ بِرَأيِهِ فَقَدْ هَلَكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is content with his [own] opinion is indeed doomed.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ اسْتَبَدَّ بِرَأيِهِ خَفَّتْ وَطْأَتُهُ على أعْدائِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, When one is opinionated, it becomes easy for his enemies to defeat him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ اسْتَقْبَلَ وُجوهَ الآراءِ عَرَفَ مَواقِعَ الخَطاءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who takes the different opinions into consideration recognizes the points of error.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ اسْتَبَدَّ بِرَأيِهِ خاطَرَ وَ غَرَّرَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is opinionated has endangered and imperilled [himself].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : المُسْتَبِدُّ مُتَهَوِّرٌ فِي الخَطاءِ وَ الغَلَطِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The opinionated one falls into error and blunder.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَدْ أخْطَاءَ المُسْتَبِدُّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Indeed the opinionated one has made an error [by not considering the other opinions].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ اسْتَبَدَّ بِرَأيِهِ زَلَّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is opinionated [and headstrong] slips.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلاِسْتِبْدادُ بِرَأيِكَ يُزِلُّكَ وَيُهَوِّرُكَ فِي المَهاوي
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Being opinionated will make you slip and will cause you to fall into an abyss.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِئْسَ الاِسْتِعْدادُ الاِستِبْدادُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, How bad a disposition opinionatedness [and arbitrariness] is!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : المُرائي ظاهِرُهُ جَميلٌ وَباطِنُهُ عَلِيلٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The outside of the one who shows off is beautiful but his inside is sickly.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اِعْمَلُوا في غَيْرِ رِياء وَ لا سُمْعَة فَإنَّهُ مَنْ يَعْمَلْ لِغَيرِ اللّهِ يَكِلْهُ اللّهُ سُبْحانَهُ إلى مَنْ عَمِلَ لَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Work without seeking to show off or for the sake of renown, for indeed the one who works for other than Allah is left by Allah to the one whom he worked for.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلرِّياءُ إشْراكٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Showing off is [a form of] ascribing partners [to Allah].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : آفَةُ العِبادَةِ الرِّياءُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The bane of worship is showing off.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : يَسيرُ الرِّياءِ شِرْكٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The smallest amount of showing off is polytheism.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لِسانُ المُرائي جَميلٌ وَ في قَلْبِهِ الدَّاءُ الدَّخيلُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The words of the one who shows off are beautiful, but in his heart there is an internal disease.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رُبَّ رَباح (أرباح تَؤُلُ) يَؤُلُ إلى خُسْران
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Many a profit turns back into loss.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الرّابِحُ مَنْ باعَ الدُّنيا بِالآخِرَةِ وَ اسْتَبْدَلَ بِالآجِلَةِ عَنِ العاجِلَةِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The gainer is one who has sold this world for the Hereafter and has exchanged the transient for the eternal.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اِجْعَلُوا كُلَّ رَجائِكُمْ لِلّهِ سُبْحانَهُ وَ لا تَرْجُوا أحَداً سِواهُ فَإنَّهُ ما رَجا أحدٌ غَيْرَ اللّهِ تعالى إلاّ خابَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keep all your hope for Allah, the Glorified, and do not have hope [in] anyone other than Him, for indeed no one has hoped in other than Allah, the Exalted, but that he has been disappointed.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أعْظَمُ البَلاءِ اِنْقِطاعُ الرَّجاءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The greatest affliction is the severance of hope.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الرَّجاءُ لِرَحْمَةِ اللّهِ أنْجَحُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Hope in the mercy of Allah brings more success.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّكُمْ إنْ رَجَوْتُمْ اللّهَ بَلَغْتُمْ آمالَكُمْ وَ إنْ رَجَوْتُمْ غَيرَ اللّهِ خابَتْ أمانيُّكم وآمالُكُمْ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Verily, if you have hope in Allah you will attain your hopes, but if you have hope in other than Allah then your hopes and aspirations will be frustrated.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رُبَّ رَجاء يُؤَدّي إلى حِرْمان
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Many a hope leads to deprivation.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رُبَّ رَجاء خائِب لأِْمَل كاذِب
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Many a frustrated hope is brought about by a false aspiration.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُنْ لِما لاتَرْجُو أقْرَبُ مِنْكَ لِما تَرْجُو
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be closer to that which you do not hope for than [you are to] that which you hope for.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لِكُلِّ غَيْبَة إيابٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, For every absence, there is a return.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَرُبَّما قَرُبَ البَعيدُ وَ بَعُدَ القَريبُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, At times the distant may come close and the close may become distant.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ رَجاكَ فَلا تُخَيِّبْ أمَلَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, When one has hope in you, [then] do not disappoint his hope.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفِ الكَرَمَ مِنْ طَبْعِهِ فَلا تَرْجُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, When one is not known to have a generous nature, [then] do not have hope in him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ ذَا الَّذي يَرْجُو فَضْلَكَ إذا قَطَعْتَ ذَوي رَحِمِكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Who would have hope in your kindness when you have cut off ties with your near relatives?!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ جَعَلَ اللّهَ سُبْحانَهُ مَوْئِلَ رَجائِهِ كَفاهُ أمْرَ دينِهِ وَ دُنياهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Whoever makes Allah, the Glorified, the refuge of his hopes, He will suffice him in his religious and worldly affairs.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ هانَتْ عَلَيهِ نَفْسُهُ فَلا تَرْجُ خَيْرَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, When one takes himself to be lowly, [then] do not expect [or hope] for any good from him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ كَفَّ شَرَّهُ فَارْجُ خَيْرَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who does no evil to others, [then] expect good from him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لا تَرْجُ إلاّ رَبَّكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not have hope [or expectation] except from your Lord.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتَرْجُ ما تُعَنَّفُ بِرَجائِكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not hope in that which will cause you to receive rebuke for your hope.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتُخاطِرْ بِشَيْء رَجاءَ أكْثَرَ مِنْهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not risk anything with the hope of getting more than it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتَرْجُوَنَّ فَضْلَ مَنَّان وَ لا تَأتَمِنِ الأحْمَقَ وَ الخَوَّانَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Never have hope in the favour of one who makes you feel obliged, and do not rely upon the fool and the traitor.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Hope in [the Mercy of] Allah and [in] Others
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : يا أباذَرّ إنَّكَ (إنْ) غُضِبْتَ لِلّهِ فَارْجُ مَنْ غُضِبْتَ لَهُ إنَّ القَوْمَ خافُوكَ على دُنْياهُمْ وَ خِفْتَهُم على دينِكَ فَاتْرُكْ في أيْديهِمْ ما خافُوكَ عَلَيْهِ وَ اهْرُبْ مِنْهُمْ بِما خِفْتَهُمْ عَلَيْهِ فَما أحْوَجَهُمْ إلى ما مَنَعْتَهُمْ وَ ما أغْناكَ عَمَّا مَنَعُوكَ وَلَوْ أنَّ السَّمواتِ وَ الأرضَ كانَتا على عَبْد رَتْقاً ثُمَّ اتَّقَى اللّهَ لَجَعلَ لَهُ مِنْهُما مَخْرَجاً فلا يُؤْنِسَنَّكَ إلاَّ الحَقُّ وَ لا يُوحِشَنَّكَ إلاَّ الباطِلُ فَلَو قَبِلْتَ دُنياهُمْ لأَحَبُّوكَ وَ لَوْ قَرَضْتَ مِنْها لأَمِنُوكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, O Aba Dharr! Indeed you got angry for the sake of Allah so have hope in the One whom you got angry for. Indeed the people feared you in the matter of their world while you feared them for your faith. Then leave to them that for which they are afraid of you and get away from them with that which you feared them for. How needy they are for that which you dissuade them from and how needless you are of that which they deny you. Even if the skies and the earth were closed to an individual and [then] he feared Allah, Allah would most certainly open a way for him in them. So let nothing give you comfort but the truth and let nothing distress you except falsehood. If you would have accepted their world [and its attractions] they would have loved you, and if you had shared in it they would have given you asylum.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِبَذْلِ الرَّحْمَةِ تُسْتَنْزَلُ الرَّحْمَةُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, By showing compassion, [divine] mercy descends.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَحْمَةُ الضُّعَفاءِ تَسْتَنْزِلُ الرَّحْمَةَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Being compassionate to the weak brings down [divine] mercy.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَحْمَةُ مَنْ لا يَرْحَمُ تَمْنَعُ الرَّحْمَةَ وَ اسْتِبْقاءُ مَنْ لا يُبْقي يُهْلِكُ الاُمَّةَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Showing compassion to one who does not show compassion [to others] prevents [divine] mercy, and sparing one who does not spare others destroys the nation.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : عَجِبْتُ لِمَنْ يَرْجُو رَحْمَةَ مَنْ فَوْقَهُ كَيْفَ لايَرحَمُ مَنْ دُونَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, I am amazed at the one who hopes for the mercy of one who is above him, how can he not show compassion to the one who is below him?!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أَولَى النَّاسِ بِالرَّحْمَةِ المُحْتاجِ إلَيْها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The most deserving of [showing] mercy among the people is the one who is most in need of it [himself].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أبْلَغُ ما تَسْتَدِرُّ بِهِ الرَّحمَةُ أنْ تُضْمَرَ لِجَميعِ النَّاسِ الرَّحْمَةُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The best thing that draws forth mercy is having compassion for all people [in your heart].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إذا عَجَزَ عَنِ الضُّعَفاءِ نَيْلُكَ فَلْتَسَعْهُمْ رَحْمَتُكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, When you are incapable of helping the weak [and needy] then let your compassion encompass them.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كما تَرْحَمُ تُرْحَمُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Just as you show mercy, mercy will be shown to you.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمْ لَمْ يُرْحَمْ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who shows no mercy will be shown no mercy.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ لَمْ يَرْحَمِ النَّاسَ مَنَعَهُ اللّهُ رَحْمَتَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who shows no mercy to the people, Allah will withhold His mercy from him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ لَمْ تَسْكُنِ الرَّحْمَةُ قَلْبَهُ قَلَّ لِقاؤُها لَهُ عِنْدَ حاجَتِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One in whose heart there exists no mercy, meets less of it (mercy) when he needs it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ تَرَحَّمَ رُحِمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who shows mercy is shown mercy.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مِنَ الكِرامِ تَكُونُ الرَّحْمَةُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, It is by the honourable that mercy is shown.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مِنْ أوْكَدِ أسْبابِ العَقلِ رَحْمَةُ الجُهَّالِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One of the surest means of intelligence is showing mercy to the ignorant.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِصِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ تَسْتَدِرُّ النِّعَمُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, By keeping ties with near relatives, blessings flow forth [abundantly].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِقَطيعَةِ الرَّحِمِ تُسْتَجْلَبُ النِّقَمُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, By cutting off ties with near relatives, [divine] retributions are brought down.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِرُّ الرَّجُلِ ذَوي رَحِمِهِ صَدَقَةٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The kindness of a person towards his near relatives is a [form of] charity.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : حِراسَةُ النِّعَمِ في صِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The protection of blessings is in keeping ties with near relatives.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : حُلُولُ النِّقَمِ في قَطيعَةِ الرَّحِمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The descending of [divine] retributions is in cutting off ties with near relatives.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رُبَّ قَريب أبْعدُ مِنْ بَعيد
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Many a near relative is farther away than one who is distant [or unrelated].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رُبَّ مُواصَلَة خَيْرٌ مِنْها القَطيعَةُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Many ties are better to cut off than to keep.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رُبَّ مُواصَلَة أدَّتْ إلى تَثْقيل
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Sometimes [certain] ties may result in heavy burdens [and obligations].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ تُدِرُّ النِّعَمَ وَ تَدْفَعُ النِّقَمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives makes blessings flow forth and repels calamities.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ مِنْ أحسَنِ الشِّيَمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives is one of the best practices.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ مَنْماةٌ لِلْعَدَدِ مَثْراةٌ لِلنِّعَمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives makes the numbers grow and multiplies the blessings.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ تَسُوءُ العَدُوَّ وتَقي مَصارِعَ السُّوءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives hurts the enemy and protects one from falling into evil places of destruction.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الأرحامِ تُثْمِرُ الأمْوالَ وَ تُنْسِيُ فِي الآجالِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives produces wealth and delays death.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ تُوجِبُ المَحَبَّةَ وَ تَكْبِتُ العَدُوَّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives brings about love and restrains the enemy.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ تُوَسِّعُ الآجالَ وَ تُنْمِي الأمْوالَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives increases [ones] lifespan and makes wealth grow [and multiply].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الأرحامِ مِثْراةٌ فِي الأموالِ مِرْفَعَةٌ لِلأعْمالِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives is a means of increasing wealth and a raiser of [good] deeds.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الأرْحامِ مِنْ أفْضَلِ شِيَمِ الكِرامِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives is from the best practices of the honourable ones.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ عِمارَةُ النِّعَمِ وَ دِفاعَةُ النِّقَمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives makes blessings flourish and repels [divine] retributions.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ تُنْمِي العَدَدَ وَ تُوجِبُ السُّؤْدَدَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives makes the numbers grow and results in eminence.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ ضَيَّعَهُ الأقْرَبُ اُقيحَ لَهُ الأبْعَدُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is neglected by the near one is [made dear to and] supported by the distant [unrelated] one.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ جَفا أهْلَ رَحِمِهِ فَقَدْ شانَ كَرَمَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who wrongs his near relative has indeed disgraced his honour.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مِنَ الكَرَمِ صِلَةُ الرَّحِمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Part of honour is keeping ties with near relatives.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : في صِلَةِ الرَّحِمِ حِراسَةُ النِّعَمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, In keeping ties with near relatives there is the safeguarding of blessings.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : في قَطيعةِ الرَّحِمِ حُلُولُ النِّقَمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, In cutting off ties with near relatives there is the coming down of [divine] retributions.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : وَصِلَةَ الأرْحامِ مَنْماةً لِلْعَدَدِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Keeping ties with near relatives is a means of growing the numbers.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَطيعةُ الرَّحِمِ تَجْلُبُ النِّقَمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Cutting off ties with near relatives brings [divine] retributions.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَطيعَةُ الرَّحِمِ مِنْ أقْبَحِ الشِّيَمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Cutting off ties with near relatives is one of the ugliest practices.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَطيعةُ الرَّحِمِ تُزيلُ النِّعَمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Cutting off ties with near relatives causes the cessation of blessings.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيْسَ مَعَ قَطيعَةِ الرَّحِمِ نَماءٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, There is no increase [in wealth] with cutting off ties with near relatives.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيْسَ لِقاطِعِ رَحِم قَريبٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, No one is considered close by the one who cuts off ties with his near relatives.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَيْسَ مِنَ الكَرَمِ قَطيعةُ الرَّحِمِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, It is not part of honour to cut off ties with near relatives.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أكْرِمْ عشيَرتَكَ فَإنَّهُمْ جَناحُكَ الَّذي بِهِ تَطيرُ وَ أصْلُكَ الَّذي إلَيهِ تَصيرُ وَ يَدُكَ الَّتي بِها تَصُولُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Honour your family, for indeed they are your wings by which you fly, and your origin to which you return, and your hand by which you attack [the enemy].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أكْرِمْ ذَوي رَحِمِكَ وَ وَقِّرْ حَليمَهُمْ وَ احْلُمْ عَنْ سَفيِهِهِمْ وَ تَيَسَّرْ لِمُعسِرِهِمْ فَإنَّهُمْ لَكَ نِعْمَ العُدَّةُ فِي الشِدَّةِ والرَّخاءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Honour your near relatives, revere the forbearing from among them, be patient with the foolish among them and lighten the burden for the poor among them, for verily they are the best means of support [and assistance] in times of difficulty and ease.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أفْضَلُ الشِّيَمِ صِلَةُ الأرْحامِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The best practice is keeping ties with near relatives.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ الرَّحِمَ إذا تماسَّتْ تَعاطَفَتْ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Indeed when near relatives are in contact, they become kind to each other.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ صِلَةَ الأرْحامِ لَمِنْ مُوجِباتِ الإسْلامِ وإنَّ اللّهَ سُبحانَهُ أمَرَ بِإكْرامِها وَ إنَّهُ تعالى يَصِلُ مَنْ وَصَلَها وَ يَقْطَعُ مَنْ قَطَعَها وَ يُكْرِمُ مَنْ أكرَمَها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Verily keeping ties with near relatives is from the obligatory acts of Islam, and Allah, the Glorified, has commanded that they should be honoured, and He, the Most High, keeps ties with the one who keeps ties with them and cuts off ties with the one who cuts off ties with them and honours the one who honours them.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : التَّجَنّي أوَّلُ القَطيعَةِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Making false accusations is the first step in cutting off ties.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ألا لايَعدِلَنَّ أحَدُكُمْ عَنِ القَرابَةِ يَرى بِهَا الخَصاصَةَ أنْ يَسُدَّها بِالَّذي لايَزيدُهُ إنْ أمْسَكَهُ وَ لايَنْقُصُهُ إنْ أنْفَقَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Beware! None of you should ever abandon [any of] his near relatives whom he finds in [a state of] poverty and [neither should he] desist in helping them with that which will not increase if he withholds it nor will it decrease if he spends it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : التَّجَنّي رَسُولُ القَطيعَةِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, False accusation is the messenger of severance of ties.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ما آمَنَ بِاللّهِ مَنْ قَطَعَ رَحِمَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, He who cuts off ties [with near relatives] does not believe in Allah.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ما أقْبَحَ القَطيعَةَ بَعْدَ الصِّلَةِ وَ الجَفاءَ بَعْدَ الإخاءِ وَ العَداوَةَ بَعْدَ الصَّفاءِ وَ زَوالَ الاُلْفَةِ بَعْدَ اسْتِحْكامِها
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, How ugly is cutting off ties after establishing them, and alienation after brotherhood, and enmity after goodwill, and the disappearance of affinity after it had been strengthened.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ ذَا الَّذي يَثِقُ بِكَ إذا غَدَرْتَ بِذَوي رَحِمِكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Who will ever trust you when you are disloyal to your near relatives?
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Near Relatives and Keeping or Cutting Off Ties with Them
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رُبَّ بَعيد أقْرَبُ مِنْ كُلِّ قريب
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Many a distant one is closer than every near one.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : عِنْدَ تَضائُقِ حِلَقِ البَلاءِ يَكُونُ الرَّخاءُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, When the circle of affliction tightens, ease follows.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : فِي الرَّخاءِ تَكُونُ فَضيلَةُ الشُّكْرِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The excellence of gratitude is in times of ease.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ لَمْ تَرْتَدِعْ يَجْهَلْ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who does not restrain himself [from evils and excesses] is ignorant.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِتَجَنُّبِ الرَّذائِلِ تَنْجُو مِنَ العابِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, By keeping away from depravities, you are saved from disgrace.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتَغْنَ بِالرَّذائِلِ فَتَسْقُطَ قيمَتُكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not make yourself needless through depravities such that your value is dropped.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لايُفْلِحُ مَنْ يَتَبَجَّجُ بِالرَّذائِلِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, He who delights in depravities will never succeed.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كَفى بِالمَرْءِ رَذيلَةً أنْ يُعْجِبَ بِنَفْسِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, It is sufficient of a depravity for one to be pleased [and impressed] with himself.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلاِنحِطاطُ إلَى الرَّذائِلِ سَهْلٌ مُرْد
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Decline into depravities easily destroys.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اِسْتَنْزِلُوا الرِّزقَ بِالصَّدَقَةِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Make sustenance come down by [giving] charity.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّ اللّهَ سُبْحانَهُ أبى أنْ يَجْعَلَ أرزاقَ عِبادِهِ المُؤْمِنينَ إلاّ مِنْ حَيثُ لايَحتَسِبُونَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Verily Allah, the Glorified, dislikes to put the sustenance of his believing servants except [in places] from where they least expect it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : تَنْزِلُ مِنَ اللّهِ المَعُونَةُ عَلى قَدْرِ المَؤُنَةِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Assistance comes down from Allah to the extent of the provisions [that are required for sustenance].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رِزْقُكَ يَطْلُبُكَ فَأرِحْ نَفْسَكَ مِنْ طَلَبِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Your sustenance is seeking you, so spare yourself the trouble of seeking it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَضِيَ بِالحِرمانِ طالِبُ الرِّزقِ مِنَ اللِّئامِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, He who seeks sustenance from the wicked has accepted deprivation.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رِزْقُ كُلِّ امْرِء مُقَدَّرٌ كَتَقْديرِ أجَلِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The sustenance of every person is preordained just as the end of his life is predetermined.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رِزقُ المَرْءِ على قَدْرِ نِيَّتِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The sustenance of a person is proportionate to his intention.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : سَوْفَ يَأتيكَ ما قُدِرَ لَكَ فَخَفِّضْ فِي المُكْتَسَبِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, That which has been decreed for you will come to you, so take it easy in your earning.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : كُلُّكُمْ عِيالُ اللّهِ وَ اللّهُ سُبْحانَهُ كافِلُ عِيالِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, All of you are the dependants of Allah, and Allah, the Glorified, takes care of His dependants.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لِكُلِّ رِزق سَبَبٌ فَأَجْمِلُوا فِي الطَّلَبِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, For every sustenance there is a means, so be moderate in your seeking [it].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَنْ يَسْبِقَكَ إلى رِزْقِكَ طالِبٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, No [other] seeker will ever overtake you in [acquiring] your sustenance.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَنْ يَغلِبَكَ على ما قُدِّرَ لَكَ غالِبٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Nobody will ever overcome you in getting that which has been decreed for you.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَنْ يَفُوتَكَ ما قُسِمَ لَكَ فَأَجْمِلْ فِي الطَّلَبِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, That which has been apportioned for you will never escape you so be moderate in what you seek.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَمْ يَفُتْ نَفْساً ما قُدِّرَ لَها مِنَ الرِّزقِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, That sustenance which has been decreed for a soul shall not escape it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَوْ جَرَتِ الأرْزاقُ بِالألبابِ وَ العُقُولِ لَمْ تَعِشِ البَهائِمُ وَالحَمْقى
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, If sustenance was bestowed based on understanding and intellect, the animals and foolish ones would not live.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ اهْتَمَّ بِرِزقِ غَد لَمْ يُفْلِحْ أبَداً
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is [too] concerned about his next days sustenance will never be successful.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مِنْ هَنيءِ النِّعَمِ سَعَةُ الأرْزاقِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One of the most pleasant blessings is abundant sustenance.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : نِعْمَ البَرَكَةُ سَعَةُ الرِّزقِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, What a good blessing abundant sustenance is!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لايَكُنِ المَضْمُونُ لَكَ طَلَبُهُ أَوْلى بِكَ مِنَ المَفْرُوضِ عَلَيْكَ عَمَلُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not let seeking that which is guaranteed for you be more important to you than the action which has been made obligatory upon you to perform.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاتَحْمِل هَمَّ يَوْمِكَ الَّذي لَمْ يَأتِكَ على يَوْمِكَ الَّذي قَدْ أتاكَ فَإنَّهُ إنْ يَكُنْ مِنْ عُمْرِكَ يَأتِكَ اللّهُ سُبْحانَهُ فيهِ بِرِزقِكَ وَ إنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ مِنْ عُمْرِكَ فَما هَمُّكَ بِما لَيْسَ مِنْ أجَلِكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Do not let the worry of the day which has not come upon you bear on the day which has [already] come upon you, for indeed if it will be from your lifetime, [then] Allah, the Glorified, will grant your sustenance in it and if it is not from your lifetime then what worry do you have for that which is not for you?!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لايُنالُ الرِّزقُ بالتَّعَنّي
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Sustenance is not acquired by toiling [for it].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لايَمْلِكُ إمْساكَ الأرْزاقِ وَ إدْرارَها إلاّ الرَّزّاقُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, No one possesses the ability to withhold sustenance or to bestow it except the Sustainer.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : يَطْلُبُكَ رِزْقُكَ أشَدَّ مِنْ طَلَبِكَ لَهُ فَأَجمِلْ في طَلَبِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Your sustenance seeks you with more intensity than you seek it, so be moderate in what you seek.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أجْمِلُوا فِي الطَّلَبِ فَكَمْ مِنْ حَريص خائب و مُجْمِل لَم يَخِبْ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be moderate in what you seek, for how many greedy people have been disappointed and how many who are moderate have not been unsuccessful!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الرِّزقُ يَطْلُبُ مَنْ لايَطْلُبُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Sustenance seeks the one who does not seek it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلأرْزاقُ لاتُنالُ بِالحِرْصِ وَ المُطالَبَةِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Sustenance is not acquired by greed or by being sought after.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنّي مُسْتَوْف رِزقي وَ مُجاهِدٌ نَفْسي وَ مُنْتَه إلى قِسْمي
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Indeed I will complete my sustenance, and struggle with my [lower] self and will end with my [allotted] portion.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّكَ مُدْرِكٌ قِسْمَكَ وَ مَضْمُونٌ رِزْقَكَ وَ مُسْتَوْف ما كُتِبَ لَكَ فَأَرِحْ نَفْسَكَ مِنْ شَقاءِ الحِرْصِ وَ مَذَلَّةِ الطَّلَبِ وَ ثِقْ بِاللّهِ وَ خَفِّضْ فِي المُكْتَسَبِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Verily you will acquire your share - your sustenance is guaranteed and that which has been decreed for you will be fulfilled, so spare yourself the trouble of the wretchedness of greed and the humiliation of seeking [from others]; trust in Allah and take it easy in your earning.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اِرْضَ تَسْتَرِحْ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be satisfied and you will be relaxed.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اِرْضَ بِما قُسِمَ لَكَ تَكُنْ مُؤْمِناً
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be satisfied with that which has been apportioned for you and you will be a [true] believer.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اِرْضَ مِنَ الرِّزقِ بِما قُسِمَ لَكَ تَعِشْ غَنيّاً
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Be satisfied with the sustenance that has been apportioned for you and you will live a life of prosperity.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلرِّزقُ مَقْسُومٌ الحَريصُ مَحْرُومٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The sustenance has been apportioned; the greedy has been deprived [of what he seeks beyond his share].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ طَلَبَ الزِّيادةَ وَقَعَ فِي النُّقصانِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who seeks more [than what has been apportioned for him], falls into loss.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قَدْ يُرْزَقُ المَحْرُومُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The deprived may [also] be granted sustenance.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.chapter: Sustenance and One Who Seeks It
_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّكَ لَسْتَ بِسابِق أجَلَكَ وَ لا بِمَرْزُوقِ ما لَيْسَ لَكَ فَلِما ذا تُشْقي نَفْسَكَ يا شَقِيُّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Neither will you overtake your death nor will you get the sustenance that is not [decreed] for you, so why are you making yourself miserable O wretched one?!
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أقَلَّ الاِسْتِرسالَ سَلِمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who confides less in others is safe.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أكْثَرَ الاِسْتِرسالَ نَدِمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who confides a lot in others regrets.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قِلَّةُ الاِسْتِرسالِ إلَى النَّاسِ أحْزَمُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Confiding less in people [and not telling them your secrets] is more judicious.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِعَقلِ الرَّسولِ وَ أدَبِهِ يُسْتَدَلُّ على عَقْلِ المُرْسِلِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, By the intelligence of the messenger and his etiquette, the intelligence of the sender [of the message] is gauged.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَسُولُ الرَّجُلِ تَرْجُمانُ عَقْلِهِ وَ كِتابُهُ أبْلَغُ مِنْ نُطْقِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, A persons messenger the interpreter of his reason, and his written message is more conveying than his speech.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَسُولُكَ تَرْجُمانُ عَقْلِكَ وَ احْتِمالُكَ دَليلُ حِلْمِكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, You messenger is the interpreter of your intellect, and your tolerance is an indication of your forbearance.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَسُولُكَ ميزانُ نُبْلِكَ وَ قَلَمُكَ أبْلَغُ مَنْ يَنْطِقُ عَنْكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Your messenger is the gauge of your nobility, and your pen is the most eloquent thing that speaks on your behalf.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَقَدْ أخْطَاءَ العاقِلُ اللاَّهي الرُّشْدَ وَ أصابَهُ ذُوالاِجْتِهادِ والجِدِّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Indeed the intelligent one who is heedless strays from the path of right guidance and the one who strives with seriousness [to find it] gets it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لَنْ تَعْرِفُوا الرُّشْدَ حتّى تَعْرِفُوا الَّذي تَرَكَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, You will never know rectitude until you know the one who has abandoned it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ اسْتَرشَدَ عَلِمَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who seeks right guidance becomes knowledgeable [about it].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنِ اسْتَرشَدَ غَوِيّاً ضَلَّ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who seeks right guidance from the deviated, goes astray.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ خالفَ رُشْدَهُ تَبِعَ هَواهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who opposes his reason follows his desires.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أفْضَلُ السُّبُلِ الرُّشْدُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The best of paths is [the path of] right guidance.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : قدْ أصابَ المُسْتَرْشِدُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, It is possible for the seeker of right guidance to attain it.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ أصْدَقَكَ في نَفْسِكَ فَقَدْ أرْشدَكَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is truthful to you about yourself has indeed guided you aright.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : لاضَلالَ مَعَ إرشاد
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, There is no going astray with right guidance.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ وُفِّقَ لِرَشادِهِ تَزَوَّدَ لِمَعادِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is successful in his [attaining] rectitude acquires provisions for his Hereafter.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ رَضِيَ بِالقَضاءِ اِسْتَراحَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is pleased with the decree [of Allah] is at ease.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : أجدَرُ الأشياءِ بِصِدقِ الإيمانِ اَلرِّضا والتَّسْليمُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The thing which is most befitting of true faith is being satisfied [with what has been decrees] and total submission [to Allah].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : الرِّضا غَناءٌ والسُّخْطُ عَناءٌ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Satisfaction is abundance while disappointment is agony.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلرِّضا يَنْفي الحَزَنَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Satisfaction dispels sadness.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلرِّضا ثَمَرَةُ اليَقينِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Satisfaction [with the decree of Allah] is the fruit of certitude.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : اَلرِّضا بِقَضاءِ اللّهِ يُهَوِّنُ عَظيمَ الرَّزايا
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Satisfaction with the decree of Allah makes great calamities easy [to bear].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنْ عَقَدْتَ أيْمانَكَ فَارْضَ بِالمَقْضِيِّ عَلَيكَ وَ لَكَ وَ لا تَرْجُ أحَداً إلاَّ اللّهَ سُبْحانَهُ وانْتَظِرْ ما أتاكَ بِهِ القَدَرُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, If you have made a covenant [to believe in Allah] then be satisfied with that which has been decreed against you and for you, and do not have hope in anyone other than Allah, the Glorified, and await that which is brought to you by [divine] decree.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إنَّكُمْ إنْ رَضيتُمْ بِالقَضاءِ طابَتْ عَيْشَتُكُمْ وَ فُزْتُمْ بِالغَناءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Indeed if you are pleased with the decree [of Allah], your lives will become enjoyable and you will attain prosperity.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : إذا لَمْ يَكُنْ ما تُريدُ فلا تُبَلْ كَيفَ كُنْتَ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, When what you want does not happen, then do not fret about how you were [and be satisfied with the decree of Allah].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : بِالرِّضا بِقَضاءِ اللّهِ يُسْتَدَلُّ على حُسْنِ اليَقينِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, By satisfaction with the decree of Allah, the strength of [ones] certitude is evinced.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : تَوَخَّ رِضَا اللّهِ وَ تَوَقَّ سَخَطَهُ وَ زَعْزِعْ قَلْبَكَ بِخَوفِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Seek the pleasure of Allah and fear His displeasure, and let your heart become unsettled by [your] fear of Him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : تَحَرَّ رِضَا اللّهِ بِرِضاكَ بِقَدَرِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Seek the pleasure of Allah by being satisfied with His decree.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : تَحَرَّ رِضا اللّهِ وَ تَجَنَّبْ سَخَطَهُ فَإنَّهُ لايَدَىْ لَكَ بِنَقِمَتِهِ وَ لا غِنى بِكَ عَنْ مَغفِرَتِهِ و لا مَلْجَأَ لَكَ مِنْهُ إلاَّ إلَيهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Seek the pleasure of Allah, and keep away from His displeasure, for indeed there is none who can save you from His retribution and there is nothing that can make you needless of His forgiveness, and there is no refuge for you from Him except with Him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : ثَمَرَةُ الرِّضا الغَناءُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The fruit of satisfaction is prosperity.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَأسُ الطَّاعَةِ الرِّضا
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The pinnacle of worship is satisfaction [with the decree of Allah].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : رَأسُ القَناعَةِ الرِّضا
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, The cornerstone of contentment is satisfaction [with the decree of Allah].
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : عَلَيْكَ بِالرِّضا فِي الشِّدَّةِ وَ الرَّخاءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Remain satisfied in times of difficulty and ease.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ رَضِيَ بِالقَضاءِ طابَتْ عيشَتُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Whoever is pleased with [Allahs] decree, his life becomes pleasant.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ رَضِيَ بِالقَدَرِ اسْتَخَفَّ بِالغِيَرِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is satisfied with the decree [of Allah] takes the changing circumstances [of his life] lightly.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ رَضِيَ بِالمَقْدُورِ قَوِيَ يَقينُهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, Whoever is satisfied with what has been decreed, his certitude is strengthened.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ حَسُنَ رِضاهُ بِالقَضاءِ حَسُنَ صَبْرُهُ عَلَى البَلاءِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One whose satisfaction with what is decreed is good, his patience in [times of] tribulation will be good.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ رَضِيَ بِقِسْمِ اللّهِ لَمْ يَحزَنْ على ما فاتَهُ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is pleased with the share allotted to him by Allah does not grieve for that which escapes him.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي

_source.arabic: الإمامُ عليٌّ (عَلَيهِ الّسَلامُ) : مَنْ رَضِيَ بِما قَسَمَ اللّهُ لَهُ لَمْ يَحْزَنْ على ما في يَدِ غَيْرِهِ
_source.english: Imam Ali (AS) said, One who is satisfied with what Allah has allotted for him does not become sad about what others possess.
_source.source: ʿAbd al-Wāḥid b. Muḥammad al-Tamīmī al-Āmidī
_source.source_ar: عبد الواحد بن محمد التميمي الآمدي
